faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes CLC 220 CDI use?
faqLeft.a: The CLC 220 CDI uses the OM646 — a 2.2-litre inline-four diesel. It was fitted from 2008 to 2011 across the CL203 generation.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes CLC 220 CDI engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my CLC 220 CDI?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact engine spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM646 CLC 220 CDI engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We service the OM646 to the same standard as our other Mercedes 4-cylinder diesel rebuilds.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used CLC 220 CDI engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my CLC 220 CDI if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a CLC 220 CDI engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most CLC 220 CDI owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
